value.rationale: A complete element-centralizer distribution is a canonical nontrivial semigroup invariant, not a renamed special case. The formulas classify every element for the full unbounded dihedral family and exhibit a sharp even/odd center jump (four versus two) plus a parity-sensitive exact commutation probability converging to 5/8. This quantitative baseline is relevant to higher-rank 0-Hecke commutation and J-trivial semigroup comparisons; the core classification is not implied by known power, representation-theoretic, or algebra-center results.
